summary: Tehran said that the prerequisite for resumption of flights is the lifting of the U.S. blockade [Compiled by Lin Jiayu/Comprehensive Report] Iran announced on the 6th that it had reached a consensus with Oman on the shipping routes and management mechanism of the Strait of Hormuz, and is now entering the final stage…
